description: Report a gap or problem after attempting a task for the driver — for example, when get_evaluated_savings does not yet support a requested repair category or metro, when no active coupon was matched for a major chain, or when audit_repair_quote encountered an unparseable estimate. If the driver has a written quote, estimate, or line-item price for a repair category not listed in get_evaluated_savings, call audit_repair_quote first before reporting a gap. Only call submit_feedback once at the end of the turn after completing your best effort with get_evaluated_savings or audit_repair_quote. Never include customer names, phone numbers, emails, or 17-digit VINs.

description.description: What tool call you tried and what was missing, broken, or unclear.

error.description: Exact error received, with any personal data removed.

kind.description: What kind of gap: "missing" (unsupported repair category, metro, or chain coupon), "broken" (tool error or failed quote parse), "confusing" (unclear benchmark or statutory fee rule), or "idea".

operation.description: Tool name involved: get_evaluated_savings or audit_repair_quote.

suggestion.description: What service category, metro, or schema change would have helped.

task.description: Short phrase naming what the driver asked for, e.g. "Price wheel alignment in 78701".

name: submit_feedback
title: Report Missing Auto Service, Metro, or Tool Issue
